text: At step 12000, N=128 layer-1 energy R2 falls short of N=64 by a similar amount in seeds 22 and 23 on data_seed 1 (0.939 vs 0.973 and 0.939 vs 0.969), yet their force gaps differ about 3x (about 0.096 vs 0.032).
